scope: Every NRL club, with the mechanism from current state through to the premiership or the verified point at which that road closed.
rules: Minor Premiership and NRL Premiership are separate outcomes.
Finishing 1st-4th creates the qualifying-final pathway and permits survival after a Week 1 loss.
Finishing 5th-8th creates an elimination-final pathway with no Week 1 loss protection.
A mathematically eliminated club remains visible with the mechanism of elimination preserved.
Exact finals opponents must be updated only when seeding is verified.
No premiership probability is invented merely because a pathway exists.

finals_mechanics.top_four: 1st v 4th and 2nd v 3rd in Qualifying Finals. Winner advances directly to a Preliminary Final. Loser remains alive and hosts a Week 2 Semi-final.
finals_mechanics.positions_five_to_eight: 5th v 8th and 6th v 7th in Elimination Finals. Loser is eliminated. Winner advances to a sudden-death Semi-final.
finals_mechanics.week_three: Preliminary Finals are sudden death; winners reach the Grand Final.
finals_mechanics.grand_final: Grand Final winner is the NRL Premier.

teams.current_mechanism: Completed regular season on 42 competition points after beating Manly 31-30. They are guaranteed a top-two finish. Penrith can still take first place depending on the Panthers-Tigers result and the points-differential tiebreak.
teams.minor_premiership_road: Minor Premiership is secured if Penrith fail to win by the margin required to overtake the Warriors on the ladder tiebreak. Otherwise Warriors finish second.
teams.premiership_road: Finish 1st or 2nd -> home Qualifying Final -> if win, Week 2 off then Preliminary Final -> Grand Final; if lose Qualifying Final, remain alive -> home Semi-final -> Preliminary Final -> Grand Final.

teams.current_mechanism: Enter the final regular-season match on 40 competition points and +308 differential. Warriors have finished on 42 and +310. Penrith need a win by at least two points to take the Minor Premiership under the current tiebreak position.
teams.minor_premiership_road: Beat Wests Tigers by at least two points -> finish first and become Minor Premiers. Win by one, draw or lose -> finish second.
teams.premiership_road: Either first or second -> home Qualifying Final -> if win, Week 2 off then home Preliminary Final -> Grand Final; if lose Qualifying Final, remain alive -> home Semi-final -> Preliminary Final -> Grand Final.

teams.current_mechanism: Round 27 win moved the Dolphins to 40 competition points and secured a top-four finish. They therefore enter the qualifying-final side of the bracket.
teams.premiership_road: Finish 3rd -> away Qualifying Final against 2nd -> win gives Week 2 off and a Preliminary Final; loss still preserves season -> Semi-final -> Preliminary Final -> Grand Final.

teams.current_mechanism: Round 27 loss to South Sydney leaves the Roosters fourth. Top-four status still preserves the qualifying-final double-chance pathway.
teams.premiership_road: Finish 4th -> away Qualifying Final against 1st -> win gives Week 2 off and a Preliminary Final; loss still preserves season -> Semi-final -> Preliminary Final -> Grand Final.

teams.current_mechanism: Finals place is locked but fifth carries no Week 1 loss protection.
teams.premiership_road: 5th -> home Elimination Final against 8th -> Semi-final -> Preliminary Final -> Grand Final. Every finals match is effectively sudden death from Week 1.

teams.current_mechanism: The 50-20 Round 27 win over the Roosters locks South Sydney into sixth and a home elimination final.
teams.premiership_road: 6th -> home Elimination Final against 7th Newcastle -> Semi-final -> Preliminary Final -> Grand Final. Four straight finals wins are required.

teams.current_mechanism: Finals place is secured. Seventh enters the elimination side of the bracket and travels in Week 1.
teams.premiership_road: 7th -> away Elimination Final against 6th South Sydney -> Semi-final -> Preliminary Final -> Grand Final. Any finals loss ends the season.

teams.current_mechanism: Finals place was secured before Round 27. Eighth enters the most exposed finals route and travels to fifth in Week 1.
teams.premiership_road: 8th -> away Elimination Final against 5th Sharks -> Semi-final -> Preliminary Final -> Grand Final. Four consecutive finals wins are required.
